bestBets.overview: EARTHING ran quick time when demolishing rivals over this trip on the Pakenham synthetic. Ran six lengths quicker than BM62 winner Double Pi(stablemate). Ran well on Soft7 first up. Going much better since being gelded. LOFTY THOUGHTS has gone well in all three runs back from a spell and last start placed in near identical race. Rider sticks and positive lead is the addition of visors for the first time. BELCONY resumes  from the in-form Goodwin yard. Won first-up last preparation on good track, but then placed three times on wet ground. If you have been tracking Sheza Alibi you would have noticed Belcony running second to her in a star studded Pakenham jump out! CORONATIONHERCULES did a great job from the rear to win over 1400m at his first attempt. Time is near identical to that recorded in race Lofty Thoughts came through. ANGLAND LASS handled the 1300m first up on soft ground when looked like might have got to the front too early and was a touch vulnerable.

raceTips.comment: Coronationhercules is a brute of a horse and loved his maiden win at this track and trip last start. He is still very raw and clearly learning his craft but the removal of ear-muffs is a sign that he is improving mentally. He charged from last to win and beat subsequent Bendigo winner Diamond Eye and could potentially settle closer to the action from the favourable draw. Angland Lass won well on debut and seems capable of rising through the grades. She has a likeable racing style and maps nicely from the draw. Earthing is clearly an improved horse as a gelding this campaign and scored a strong win in fast-time at Pakenham last start.

Jewel Bay comes through the strongest last race, having been somewhat unlucky at Caulfield behind Stay Silent. The test will be whether he can sustain a run out to 1700m in what may be a fast-run race.
